### Findings
For authorized products (IDs 1 and 2, enforced via executor-bound views), the aggregation evaluates item-grain records from `order_items` joined to `products` where `status = 'Complete'` [q1]. No date filter was applied, covering all returned records. Revenue is defined as `SUM(sale_price)` (`complete_revenue`) and item count as `COUNT(*)` (`complete_items`), grouped by `brand`.

| brand | complete_revenue | complete_items |

### Limitations
- The query did not filter by date or return time-period breakdowns [q1].
- The query did not measure order volume (`COUNT(DISTINCT order_key)`) or customer counts (`COUNT(DISTINCT customer_key)`) [q1].

### Action items (proposed)
